map.API 度与密度换算 使用指南: API degree and density conversion guide
map.API 度是美国石油学会的相对密度标度：°API = 141.5/SG - 13: API degree is the American Petroleum Institute relative density scale: degrees API = 141.5/SG - 131.5 (SG is the relative density at 60 degrees F). The larger the value the lighter the oil; at 10 degrees API, SG = 1.0 (the same weight as water), above 10 it is lighter than water and below 10 heavier than water.

map.原油贸易与计价：不同产区原油以 API 度报价，需换算为比重(SG)与密度(g/: Crude oil trading and pricing: crude from different producing areas is quoted in API degrees and must be converted to specific gravity (SG) and density (g/cm3, kg/m3) before mass, volume and shipping stowage can be calculated. The tool converts between API and SG, so entering either gives the other.

map.实验室与计量交接：交接计量常以 60°F(15.6℃) 标准密度为准，本工具以: Laboratory and metrology handover: handover measurement is usually based on standard density at 60 degrees F (15.6 degrees C), and this tool converts density against a basis of water relative density 1.0 at 60 degrees F, making it easy to compare with the metrology certificate.
Common bands: API above 31.1 is light crude, 22.3-31.1 medium, 10-22.3 heavy, and below 10 extra heavy or bitumen. Light crude yields high-value refined fractions more easily and usually commands a premium.
map.炼厂装置设计与混兑：原油调和时要按密度核算混合油比重，API 度越高表示越轻、经: Refinery unit design and blending: when blending crude, the specific gravity of the mixture is calculated from the densities. A higher API degree means lighter and usually higher economic value, and the classify function quickly tells light, medium, heavy or extra heavy.
map.算例：API 度换算为相对密度与类别: Worked example: converting API gravity to relative density and category
map.输入原油 API 度、比重 SG 或密度三者之一，工具按公式 API=141.5: Enter the crude oil API gravity, the specific gravity SG, or the density. The tool converts the other two automatically with the formula API = 141.5/SG − 131.5, and classifies the crude as light, medium, heavy, or extra heavy by API gravity, so the oil quality can be grouped quickly.
map.：API=30 时 SG = 141.5/(30+131.5) = 0.8762:
: When API = 30, SG = 141.5/(30+131.5) = 0.8762 and density (water = 1.0) = 0.8762 g/cm³ = 876.2 kg/m³; classify(30): 22.3 ≤ 30 ≤ 31.1 → medium crude.
When API = 35, SG = 141.5/166.5 = 0.8498 and density 0.8498 g/cm³; classify(35) > 31.1 → light crude.
Reverse: SG = 0.85 → API = 141.5/0.85 - 131.5 = 34.97°API (light). Classification thresholds: >31.1 light, ≥22.3 medium, ≥10 heavy, <10 extra heavy / bitumen.
